name: a-date-skill
description: Build a cute 3D-cartoon date-day website from a trip plan and two photos, with characters drawn by an image model.

plugins.name: one-day-date
plugins.description: Turn a trip plan and photos of the two of you into a deployed, interactive date website: an image model draws you as 3D-cartoon characters who walk hand in hand from stop to stop; date picker, choices, and her answers sent back to you.
